judgment.rationale: The report describes a Peek failure after copying a PDF between Explorer windows, but does not say how Peek is invoked or whether the destination file is selected after copy. A precise selection/trigger sequence is needed to distinguish input focus from cached-preview state.
evidence: Reporter says Peek does not work on copied PDF until a different file in a different window has been previewed.
No comments, attachments, or linked fixes are present.
judgment.recommended_action: Request exact trigger and selection state in a current single-file copy test.

fix_assessment.rationale: No trigger or post-copy selection details localize the failure to Peek activation or PDF preview; no code change can be grounded yet.

issue_context.summary: Peek reportedly fails on a newly copied PDF until another file in another Explorer window is previewed.
known_information: Source window is on right and destination on left.
Trying another file in same window does not recover Peek.
Trigger and destination selection state are unspecified.
inferences: Could involve stale Explorer selection/focus state or preview reuse, but report does not distinguish them.
issue_context.analysis: Use one controlled copy and explicit selection to test the reported state transition.
initial_investigation: Read issue body; no comments or linked work.

information_gaps.information: The exact Peek invocation after a drag-copy, whether the destination item is visibly selected, and whether source and destination have the same name/path before the first Peek attempt.
information_gaps.why_needed: The report describes failure after copying a PDF between Explorer windows and says Peek starts working after a different file/window is previewed, but omits trigger and selection transition. These distinguish stale selection/cache from preview support.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On current release copy one PDF between two Explorer windows, click destination file to select it, invoke Peek consistently, and report behavior before and after previewing another file.

comment.body: Thanks for describing the two-window copy sequence. Could you retry on the current release with one PDF: after the copy completes, click the destination item so it is visibly selected and invoke Peek using the same trigger each time. Please say whether it opens before previewing another file, and whether the source and destination names are identical. This will distinguish a selection/focus transition from a preview-cache issue.
